title: Masai Giraffe Facts
excerpt: The Masai giraffe is the national animal of Tanzania. Facts about the tallest animal in the world.
body:
## Masai giraffe

The Masai giraffe has jagged, leaf-like spots. It is Tanzania's national animal.

## Tall

Males can be over five metres tall.

## Tongue

A long, dark tongue helps them pick leaves from thorny acacias.

## Sleep

Giraffes sleep very little, in short sessions.

## Necks

A giraffe's neck has seven vertebrae, the same number as ours, but much longer.

## Where

In almost all northern parks except the Ngorongoro Crater floor.

## Threats

Giraffe populations have declined; conservation efforts are ongoing.
